paper.abstract_en: Attractor black holes are finite-size probes of infinite-distance limits in the vector-multiplet moduli space of type IIA Calabi-Yau compactifications. We ask whether the hypermultiplet moduli space admits analogous probes. T-dualizing BPS black holes along a Euclidean time circle and along a spatial circle, which realizes the temporal and spatial c-map, we construct the dual type IIB D-instantons and axionic strings, on $T^6/(\mathbb{Z}_2\times\mathbb{Z}_2)$ and on a generic Calabi-Yau threefold. The duality maps the ADM mass of the black hole to the instanton action and to the string tension, its entropy to the instanton measure through the BPS index, and its warp factor to the four-dimensional dilaton, which therefore always runs along the dual flows. The instanton profiles are null geodesics in the complexified moduli space, and their action is bounded from below by the square root of the black-hole entropy. Hence, at fixed four-dimensional dilaton, only instantons dual to small black holes can become unsuppressed. The strings are bound states of EFT strings. Those dual to finite-size black holes, all probe the same emergent fundamental-string limit, which survives quantum corrections to the hypermultiplet moduli space. Those dual to small black holes probe other emergent-string and decompactification limits and we discuss which of these limits survive quantum corrections.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文研究T对偶下BPS黑洞的映射，将ADM质量、熵和warp因子对应到D-instanton作用量、BPS指标测度和四维dilaton，并以复化模空间中的零测地线刻画解，理论深度高、方法论证具体；主题更贴近引力理论基础（对偶映射与涌现极限），并与黑洞热力学相关。新论文3天零引用按中性处理。
decision.abstract_zh: 吸引子黑洞是IIA型Calabi-Yau紧化中矢量多重态模空间无穷远极限的有限尺度探针。我们追问超多重态模空间是否容许类似的探针。沿欧几里得时间圆和沿空间圆对BPS黑洞做T对偶，这实现了时间c-映射与空间c-映射，我们在$T^6/(\mathbb{Z}_2\times\mathbb{Z}_2)$上以及在一般Calabi-Yau三代体上构造了对偶的IIB型D-instanton和轴子弦。该对偶将黑洞的ADM质量映射为instanton作用量和弦张力，将其熵通过BPS指标映射为instanton测度，并将其warp因子映射为四维dilaton，因此后者总是沿对偶流跑动。instanton的剖面是复化模空间中的零测地线，其作用量从下方被黑洞熵的平方根所界。因此，在固定四维dilaton时，只有对偶于小黑洞的instanton才可能变得不被压低。这些弦是EFT弦的束缚态。那些对偶于有限尺度黑洞的弦，都探测同一个涌现的基本弦极限，该极限在超多重态模空间的量子修正下仍然存活。那些对偶于小黑洞的弦则探测其它涌现弦极限与退紧化极限，我们讨论了这些极限中哪些在量子修正下存活。
